implementation.targetScope: rankItem, compareItems and rankings, including accessors, thresholds and table fuzzy-filter metadata. Native Unicode normalization replaces the embedded accent table and declared remove-accents dependency.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies; independently written rank evaluator, without copied upstream runtime.
Does not mutate caller options; frozen objects work.
Canonically equivalent Latin accent spellings rank equally; stacked marks are fully removed and uppercase Ł remains uppercase. Unrelated scripts and sharp-s are preserved.
Types represent fractional subsequence scores and nullable/readonly accessor results.
